map.输入任意三个已知量，求解第四个未知量。R = 8.314 J/(mol·K)。: Enter any three of pressure, volume, moles and temperature to solve the fourth with the ideal gas law PV = nRT (R = 8.314 J/mol·K).
map.公式：PV = nRT。标准状况下（0 °C，1 atm），1 mol 理想气体: Formula: PV = nRT. At standard conditions (0 °C, 1 atm), 1 mol ideal gas volume is about 22.4 L.
map.温度请使用热力学温度（开尔文 K），摄氏温度需加 273.15。: Use thermodynamic temperature (Kelvin K); Celsius needs +273.15.
map.结果适用于理想气体近似，高压或低温条件下偏差较大。: Results apply to the ideal gas approximation; deviation is larger at high pressure or low temperature.
map.气缸压缩、气球升空等场景下由已知量求压强或体积。: In cylinder compression or balloon ascent, find pressure or volume from known quantities.
map.n=1 mol、T=273.15 K、P=1 atm → V=nRT/P=1·0: n=1 mol, T=273.15 K, P=1 atm → V=nRT/P=1·0.08206·273.15/1≄22.414 L (standard molar volume).
map.取决于单位：0.08206 L·atm/(mol·K) 或 8.314 J/(m: Depends on units: 0.08206 L·atm/(mol·K) or 8.314 J/(mol·K).
map.高压低温下偏差明显，需用范德华方程等真实气体模型修正。: At high pressure and low temperature the deviation is obvious; use a real-gas model like the van der Waals equation.
map.理想气体状态方程（PV = nRT）描述了理想气体的压强、体积、物质的量和温度之: The ideal gas law (PV = nRT) describes the relationship among pressure, volume, amount and temperature of an ideal gas, a fundamental formula in chemistry and physics.
